profile.headline: Software Developer/Engineer @ XylonaSoft Solutions Inc. | Data-driven software
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineering Manager at MCL McGill Carriers, I have over 10 years of experience in creating data-driven intelligent software for the auto-hauling industry. I have a diploma in Computer Technology/Computer Systems Technology from BCIT and a strong background in .NET technologies, including C#, ASP.NET, and SQL.

I manage the in-house software applications and interface development, working directly with stakeholders and customers to integrate ever-changing industry requirements. I also lead a team of software developers and engineers, overseeing the software development lifecycle, from design to deployment. I am passionate about building applications from the ground up, enhancing existing systems for sustainability, and meeting business needs through integration purposes. I am an excellent communicator and collaborator, able to effectively work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. I am constantly seeking innovative solutions and continuously improving processes. My goal is to deliver high-quality software solutions that add value to the organization and the industry.
